name: place_card
description: One place of a plan, with its photo and a short summary, which the phone loads from Wikipedia, so it needs no image URL. Use one per sight, beach, monastery, village or day trip.

title.description: The place's exact English Wikipedia article title, such as "Church of St. John at Kaneo"

note.description: One short line about it for this plan, such as "Best at sunset" or "2 hours"

events.name: ask_about
events.description: Tapping the card asks you about the place.

name: trip_map
description: A map of a plan with a pin for each place, drawn on the phone. Use one near the top of every trip plan.

places.description: Every place of the plan, with its coordinates

events.name: select_place
events.description: Tapping a pin asks you about that place.

name: calendar_check
description: The person's own calendar for the days of a plan, read on the phone. You never see it: use it whenever a plan has dates, so they can see what the trip would clash with.
